    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.rightMinimal_biprod_map {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts C] {A B X Y : C} (p : A ⟶ X) (q : B ⟶ Y) (hp : ∀ (a : A ⟶ A), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a p = p → CategoryTheory.IsIso a) (hq : ∀ (b : B ⟶ B), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp b q = q → CategoryTheory.IsIso b) (e : A ⊞ B ⟶ A ⊞ B) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e (CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.map p q) = CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.map p q → CategoryTheory.IsIso e

    Right minimality is preserved by the diagonal sum of two morphisms. The two diagonal blocks after Gaussian elimination still fix their respective maps.

          source
          theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.moduleProjectiveClass_of_projective_epi {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {M : FGModuleCat R} (A : FiniteProjective R) (p : ↑A ⟶ M) [CategoryTheory.Epi p] :
          moduleProjectiveClass k M = ProjectiveClass.of A - projectiveCoverClass k (CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel p)

          Any projective epimorphism computes the g-vector by subtracting the projective cover of its kernel. This is Schanuel's lemma in the split group.

          The source of an arbitrary projective epimorphism splits as the source of a cover and a projective summand killed by the epimorphism.

          theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_projectiveClass_cokernel_sub {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) :
          ∃ (K : FiniteProjective R) (i : ↑K ⟶ P.source) (r : P.source ⟶ ↑K), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp i r = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id ↑K ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp i P.differential = 0 ∧ P.projectiveClass = moduleProjectiveClass k (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) - ProjectiveClass.of K

          For every two-term presentation the discrepancy from its cokernel's g-vector is a shifted projective summand in the kernel of the differential.
